title: Segmentation of photovoltaic module cells in uncalibrated electroluminescence images
mechanism: Ridge detection of busbars and cell borders, lens distortion and perspective correction to segment cells from uncalibrated module EL images.
evidence: R: robust cell segmentation on uncalibrated EL modules (widely used, 145 citations).
adaptation: Score side: busbar / border ridge map or half-cut cut-line location as a layout channel for E1. Benchmark side: documented cell extraction for the 159k pool and new modules.
min_experiment: Arm: house + layout ridge channel, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: E1 crack precision in half-cut cells. Kill: < +0.03 relF1@2 on E1.
prior_overlap: partial: synthetic half-cut views were n.d.; an explicit layout channel was not tested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Busbar / border ridge map as a layout channel or to locate the cut line in E1 half-cut cells; documented cell extraction for the 159k pool and new module images in the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + ridge layout channel, 3-seed screen. Baseline: house. Metric: E1 crack false positives along cut line and relF1@2. Kill: < +0.02 E1 relF1@2.
